issuers.assurance_basis: ADR-0033: DEMO signer for app-store review only (sandbox rehearsal). Credentials are issued after a single-use review code with simulated identity proofing (no real person, no real document). Registered at I1 so that every production policy (I2+) rejects them; only the review policies of Tamga Verify accept them. Never valid for real use.
